content.text: In Nigeria, digital creators face a stark reality: Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Payhip are not [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/top-7-options-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-3|The Top]]. These platforms, built on centralized payment rails, exclude entire countries due to regulatory risk or currency controls. The result? Creators cannot sell their ebooks, courses, or templates globally. But the problem is deeper than payment processors. It’s about infrastructure dependency. When your commerce stack relies on platforms that can cut access without warning, you’re not building a business—you’re renting space in someone else’s. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves this at the base layer. It’s not a workaround; it’s ownership. This analysis compares real [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-countries-what-nobody-tells-5|alternatives]] to Gumroad and Payhip, evaluating how each handles restricted countries, payment speed, fees, and data ownership. The goal is clear: identify which architecture gives you permanent control, not temporary access.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad and Payhip are SaaS platforms designed for simplicity, not sovereignty. They offer hosted storefronts, payment processing, and file delivery—all in exchange for a percentage of your revenue. Their infrastructure is centralized: your products, customer data, and payment flows reside on their servers. This model works until it doesn’t. For creators in restricted countries, these platforms are inaccessible due to their reliance on Stripe and PayPal. Alternatives like Podia or Sellfy face the same limitations. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, in contrast, is decentralized. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack deploys your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, uses Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and integrates NOWPayments for crypto transactions. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. There’s no platform to revoke access. The tradeoff? You manage more pieces, but you control every layer. Gumroad offers convenience; COREMERCH offers ownership. Choose based on what you value more.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip exclude restricted countries because their payment processors do. Stripe and PayPal’s compliance policies block transactions from regions like Nigeria, Zimbabwe, and Venezuela. These platforms have no fallback mechanism. Even if you could access them, your customers would still face payment failures. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this entirely. By using NOWPayments, COREMERCH’s stacks accept 300+ cryptocurrencies without KYC or buyer accounts. Payments confirm on-chain, and delivery triggers automatically. This isn’t a workaround—it’s a structural alternative. While Gumroad and Payhip wait for Stripe to expand into new markets, sovereign stacks operate in any country with internet access. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed in 48 hours, configured for your products, and tested end-to-end. It’s not dependent on any third-party’s compliance department. If you’re in a restricted country, this is the only option that doesn’t require begging for access.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Gumroad charges 10% per transaction. Payhip starts at 5%. Both add payment processor fees on top. For a $50 product, you lose $7.50 to Gumroad and Stripe combined. Sovereign stacks flip this model. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. On a $50 sale, your fee is $0.25. Recommended networks like BSC or Solana keep transaction costs under $0.10. The real cost difference isn’t just fees—it’s control. With Gumroad, you’re locked into their pricing model. With COREMERCH, you choose your payment network, your fee structure, and your delivery method. Payment speed? Crypto transactions confirm in minutes, not days. The Edge Commerce Stack automates delivery the moment payment hits the blockchain. No waiting for payouts. No chargebacks. No platform taking a cut. If you’re selling digital products, this is the most cost-efficient architecture available.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you ownership, not access.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Gumroad and Payhip own your store, your data, and your customer relationships. They can change their terms, increase fees, or shut down your account. Sovereign infrastructure inverts this. Once deployed, your stack is yours. COREMERCH has no access. Your customer data lives in Supabase or Google Sheets—databases you control. File delivery happens via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2—storage you own. Automation is built into the backend logic. When a payment confirms, the webhook triggers delivery instantly. No manual intervention. No platform between you and your customer. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability, ensuring your order confirmations hit inboxes. This level of ownership isn’t possible with SaaS platforms. They rent you infrastructure; COREMERCH gives you the blueprints to build your own.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you need a store today and don’t mind renting infrastructure, Gumroad or Payhip might work—if you’re not in a restricted country. But if you’re in Nigeria, Zimbabwe, or Venezuela, these platforms are non-starters. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is built for creators who value ownership over convenience. It’s for those who understand that depending on platforms is a liability, not a strategy. The deployment process is straightforward: choose your stack, provide your product details, and COREMERCH handles the rest. In 48 hours, you have a fully operational store with automatic crypto payments and instant delivery. The tradeoff is clear: you manage more, but you own everything. If you’re tired of being locked out of global commerce, this is the architecture to choose. It’s not just an alternative—it’s a structural upgrade.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use Gumroad if I’m in Nigeria?
No. Gumroad relies on Stripe and PayPal, which are unavailable in Nigeria due to regulatory restrictions. Even if you could access Gumroad, your customers would face payment failures.
What cryptocurrencies does COREMERCH support?
COREMERCH integrates NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended low-fee networks include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction costs under $0.10.
Do I need technical skills to deploy a sovereign stack?
No. COREMERCH handles the deployment for you. The Edge Commerce Stack is configured, tested, and delivered ready to use. You manage your store post-deployment.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates as a payment processor, not a platform. If it fails, you can switch to another crypto payment gateway without rebuilding your stack. Your infrastructure remains yours.
Can I scale my store after deployment?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is built on scalable infrastructure (Cloudflare, Supabase). You can add more products, increase traffic, and expand globally without platform limits.
